paite: Na melmate uh dou ding a na kuan ua, sakol, kangtalai, nou sang a mipi tamzaw na muh chiang un, na lau ding uh ahi kei. Aigupta gam a pan nou hon pikhepa TOUPA na Pathian uh na kiang uah a-om hi.
heading: Kidouna Toh Kisai

paite: Kidou dia na kuan dek chiang un siampu in mipi va naih henla, houpih henla, akiang uah,
"Israelte aw, za un, tu in na melmate uh dou ding na hi ua, na lungtang uh patausak kei un. Lau kei unla, ling sam kei un, amaute lauhsak in om kei un.
Noute hon tonpih a na melmate uh hon dousak a, hon hondam ding TOUPA na Pathian uh ahi, chi hen."
Heutute'n mipite kiang ah, "Inn thak lam a lan nai lou na om uhia? A-inn ah paikik nawn hen. Kidouna ah ava si kha dia, midang in alan kha ding,"
heading: Mi Pawl Li Galdouna A Awlsakte

paite: "Grephuan bawl a, agah ne nai lou na om uhia? A-inn ah paikik nawn hen, kidouna ah ava si kha dia, midang in ane kha ding hi."
"Zikham a kiteng nai lou na om uhia? A-inn ah paikik nawn hen. Kidouna ah ava si kha dia, midang in akitenpih kha ding," chi in gen hen.
Heutute'n mipite kiang ah, "Lau leh patau na om uhia? A-inn ah paikik nawn hen, a-unaute uh lungtang amah lungtang bang in azulsak kha ding," chi lai uhen.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, heutute'n mipite kiang a thu agen khit un mipite makaih ding sepaih heutute asep ding uhi.
Dou ding kho kim na va tun chiang un lemna thu gen phot un.
heading: Gamdang Khopi A Galdoudan

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, ahon kileppih ua, ana kihon uleh hichi ahi ding a, huai a mi om tengteng nasem dia na goih ding uh ahi dia, na nna uh asem ding uhi.
Hon kileppih ut lou a, ahon na dou ding uleh umkhum un.
TOUPA na Pathian un na khut ua ahon piak hun chiang in pasal tengteng namsau in na that vek ding uh ahi.

Numei leh ataneu chikchikte uh, gante leh khua a thil omte leh huai a gallak thil tengteng nou a tuam dia na lak ding uh ahi. TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak na melmate uh a pan gallak thil na ne ding uhi.
Hiai namte khua hilou, na tenna ua kipan a kho gamla tengteng huchibang in na hih zel ding uhi.
TOUPA na Pathian un luah dia ahon piak hiai namte khuate zaw TOUPA na Pathian un thu ahon piak bang in ahing peuhmah bangmah na hawi ding uh ahi kei.
heading: Gam Chiam Khopite A Galdoudan

paite: Hitte, Amorte, Kanaante, Perizte, Hivte leh Jebuste na hihmang vek ding uhi.
Apathiante uh tung a ahih zel uh thilkihhuai tengteng ahon sinsaklouhna ding un hihmang vek un. Huchi lou in zaw TOUPA na Pathian tung ah thil na hihkhial kha ding uhi.

Lak tum a na dou uh khua sawtpi na um chiang un, asingte uh heipi in na phuk ding uh ahi kei; na nek ding uh ahi ngal a. Huai khopi douna a zat ding in leng na phuk ding uh ahi kei; huai gam a singte mihing hinna ahi ngal a.
heading: Sing Phuk Louh Ding

paite: Himahleh gah nei lou singte bel phuk in na hihse thei ding ua, na doute khua na lak zoh masiah uh adouna vanzat in na zang ding uhi.
